environment: Headless production Chromium; ANGLE SwiftShader software WebGL; 1440x900, DPR 1
scenario: Same 32-step Rankings scroll, 14px per step, 35ms requested waits; browser driver/sample overhead included. Not a hardware FPS benchmark.
notes: Before: 26 of 260 sampled interior pixels in the recommendation canvas were white while the panel extended beyond the backdrop.
After: large recommendation panels deliberately have no raster optical layer; their transparent material cannot retain that incomplete bitmap.
Package GLSL and shared WebGL renderer retained for compact surfaces. Uploaded-pixel reduction is work per identical scripted sequence, not per-second throughput.
GPU timing queries were not collected; CDP main-thread task time and WebGL call counters were measured.
texImage2D counters include both canvas texture uploads and framebuffer texture allocations. Glass measurement counters include identical QA sampling rect reads.
